title: Remembrance of the Righteous
english: The memory of the righteous brings joy to the world and enlightens it; the memory of the righteous makes humanity leap for joy. Now Anthony is remembered, and we are all enlightened by his memory. He is a citizen of heaven, a teacher of all virtue, an imitator of the incorporeal in the flesh, a light of the churches, a trainer of priests, the flower of virginity, the radiance of purity, a crown of those in mountains and caves, an example of self-control, a worker of temperance, an undefeated boxer, a pillar of the prophets, a mirror of the apostles, powerful with God and men, possessing nothing on earth while looking entirely toward heaven, lifting his eyes upward and hastening toward that prize.

He is faithful like Abraham, obedient like Isaac, patient like Jacob, and like Joseph feeding Egypt. He performed various wonders like Moses, sang like David and drove out demons, presented himself as a temple greater than God, commanded lions like Daniel, gathered the desert like the Baptist, rested on the chest of Jesus like the Theologian through evangelical study, and died daily like Paul (1 Corinthians 15:31).

But we too draw from the well and the torrent overflows; the jars are full, and 'the overflows pour out.' As much as we run, the stadium becomes greater; as much as the voyage proceeds, the boundlessness of the sea is revealed. Come then, let us also say the things of Paul: 'Time will fail me telling about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets' (Hebrews 11:32); for the father of the composed theaters took these men up in himself. For many words are needed and I am a guide to the matters, since the word grows weary of explaining the work.
